cards.public_summary: Jakobi Meyers was among four Jaguars players noted with an injury coming out of camp, with a wrist issue listed.
cards.evidence: Otherwise, the only notable injuries the Jaguars had coming out of camp came down to four key players: wide receivers Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder) and Jakobi Meyers (wrist), offensive lineman Cole Van Lanen (knee), and running back LeQuint Allen.
cards.commentary: Meyers' wrist is a preseason availability concern worth monitoring, but the report gives no severity, practice status or timetable. His next participation update will clarify any Week 1 impact.
cards.author: John Shipley
